desc:
Sneak into guarded zones, steal mysterious eggs and run back to your base before the guardian catches you! 🥚🏃

Hatch your eggs in your pen to get pets that earn money every second, then train your speed on treadmills to reach faster zones and rarer eggs.

🗺️ 14 ZONES: Forest, Snow, Jungle, Desert, Volcano, Abyss Ocean, Prehistoric, Cosmic, the Backrooms, Haunted Camp... and the NEW Brainrot, Monochrome and Keyboard Escape zones!
👹 Giant guardians: Tung Tung Sahur, the Monochrome Menace, a rainbow stag and many more
✨ Mutations: Golden, Diamond, Rainbow, Galaxy, Lava, Celestial...
📖 Complete the Index of each zone to unlock its bat
🔫 Push other players around with troll weapons
⚡ Admin Abuse event every day at 6 PM (Paris time)

Steal, hatch, upgrade and become the richest egg thief!
